Return the original label Entailment (supported), Contradiction (opposed), or NotMentioned (not settled by the document); do not substitute external law for contractual text. Decide the relation relative to the exact original hypothesis, including its negation, not whether the contract contains a prohibition. The same 17 hypotheses are checked on every document. All original text is present, with zero-based original span markers <SPAN i>...</SPAN i>. For supported/opposed hypotheses cite all original evidence span indices for that decision, including independently operative redundant support and necessary governing language. For NotMentioned return an empty evidence list. Treat conditions and exceptions within scope, and distinguish limited permission from universal permission. Give a short public reason (at most 15 words per hypothesis), then report supplied skill IDs actually used. Skills are fallible reusable inspection procedures, not facts about this NDA or automatic verdicts. All skills are visible together; public hypothesis IDs describe applicability, not hidden context isolation. Do not execute further tools, invent citations or rewrite span indices. Return exactly the supplied JSON schema with all 17 original hypothesis keys. For each emit choice, spans, reason, used_skill_ids in that order. The common schema describes permitted values, not answers about this contract. Evidence candidates are fallible, not mandatory citations; make every final label and evidence decision yourself from the complete original contract. All17 public tasks share the complete source and one-copy published_source_programs library. A question's applicable_published_skills contains ID references to those complete named records, not missing guidance. Read their inspection and the one-copy source_program_query_receipts. SOURCE_LEADS tags before original SPANs identify mechanical query/list hits by skill ID/query index, not labels or proven relevance. Only original contract text is evidence. Preserve original SPAN indices. A different question's skill is not a condition this question must satisfy. Missing skills/empty hits never mean NotMentioned. Independently inspect the entire source, reject noisy leads, retain independent/governing evidence and make every final label and complete evidence decision yourself. used_skill_ids must come from this question's ID references and may be empty.

{"full_contract_with_original_span_markers":"<SPAN 0>NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT</SPAN 0>
<SPAN 1>This Agreement made and entered into this 10th day of July, 1996 ("Effective Date"), by and between SHARP CORPORATION, a Japanese corporation, having its principal place of business at 22-22, Nagaike-cho, Abeno-ku, Osaka, Japan (hereinafter called "Sharp") and Hybrid Networks, Inc., an American corporation, having its principal place of business at 10161 Bubb Road, Cupertino, California 95014-4167 (hereinafter called "Hybrid Networks").</SPAN 1>
<SPAN 2>WITNESSETH:</SPAN 2>
<SPAN 3>WHEREAS, Sharp and Hybrid Networks both have as their purpose an interest in exploring a possible business relationship and in order for the parties to explore this relationship, it may be necessary for the parties to disclose certain of their proprietary and other information to each other, which information each of the parties regards as confidential. </SPAN 3><SPAN 4>This confidential information relates to Cable Data Modem.</SPAN 4>
<SPAN 5>NOW, THEREFORE, the parties hereto agree as follows:</SPAN 5>
<SPAN 6>1. </SPAN 6><SOURCE_LEADS>{"nda-definition-subject-scope-evidence":[0,1,2]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 7>(a) All of the confidential information (hereinafter "Confidential Information"), including, without limitation, all information relating to business plans, financial or technical matters, trade secrets, designs, know-how, inventions, operations and any other information received or acquired by one party ("Receiving Party") from the other ("Disclosing Party") in the course of exploring the possible business relationship shall be in written form and marked "Confidential," with the name of the Disclosing Party and the date of disclosure. </SPAN 7><SOURCE_LEADS>{"nda-oral-information-evidence":[0]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 8>If the Confidential Information is initially disclosed orally, it shall be reduced to written form by the Disclosing Party (including the date of the oral disclosure and name of the Disclosing Party) and presented or mailed to the Receiving Party within fifteen (15) days of the first oral disclosure.</SPAN 8>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"nda-rights-license-purpose-evidence":[2]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 9>(b) The Confidential Information shall remain the property of the Disclosing Party.</SPAN 9>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"nda-oral-information-evidence":[0]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 10>(c) All information disclosed which is not marked "Confidential," or not reduced to written form and marked "Confidential" if initially disclosed orally shall be considered to be non-confidential and shall not be subject to the obligations imposed by this Agreement. </SPAN 10><SPAN 11>All Confidential Information disclosed under this Agreement shall be limited to the subject matter mentioned in the Recital. </SPAN 11><SPAN 12>The existence and terms of this Agreement shall be treated as Confidential Information.</SPAN 12>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"nda-limited-use-evidence":[1]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 13>2. The Receiving Party shall:</SPAN 13>
<SPAN 14>(a) hold the Confidential Information in confidence and not disclose it to third parties, except in the limited cases referred to in paragraph "6"; and</SPAN 14>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"nda-limited-use-evidence":[1]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 15>(b) not use the Confidential Information for any purpose other than exploring or examining the possibility of a business relationship between the parties.</SPAN 15>
<SPAN 16>3. Either party hereto shall have the right, at any time, to terminate in writing and discussions and exchange of information in connection with the exploration of the possibilities of a business relationship between the parties without any further obligations or liabilities to the other party, other than the obligations of confidentiality hereunder, or any right or obligation relating to the Confidential Information hereunder.</SPAN 16>
<SPAN 17>4.</SPAN 17><SPAN 18>(i) The obligations of the above paragraph "2" shall not apply to any information which:</SPAN 18>
<SPAN 19>(a) is available to the public through no breach of this Agreement by the Receiving Party; or</SPAN 19>
<SPAN 20>(b) was in the possession of the Receiving Party prior to receipt from the Disclosing Party; or</SPAN 20>
<SPAN 21>(c) is received independently from a third party who is free to disclose such information to the Receiving Party; or</SPAN 21>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"nda-exception-source-development-evidence":[0]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 22>(d) is subsequently independently developed by the Receiving Party; or</SPAN 22>
<SPAN 23>(e) has been or is made public by the Disclosing Party, such as by commercial use or sale or by publications or patents, or otherwise; or</SPAN 23>
<SPAN 24>(f) is approved for release by written consent of the Disclosing Party.</SPAN 24>
<SPAN 25>(ii) Disclosure of Confidential </SPAN 25><SOURCE_LEADS>{"nda-definition-subject-scope-evidence":[1]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 26>Information shall not be precluded if such disclosure is pursuant to the requirement or request of a governmental agency or by operation of law. </SPAN 26><SPAN 27>Provided, however, the Receiving Party shall promptly give a written notice to the Disclosing party so that the Disclosing Party may seek an appropriate protective order.</SPAN 27>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"nda-post-return-retention-evidence":[2]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 28>5. All Confidential Information delivered to and/or in the possession of the Receiving Party shall be returned or delivered to the Disclosing Party, with all copies made thereof, in whatever form, if the Disclosing Party so requests.</SPAN 28>
<SPAN 29>6. The Receiving Party agrees that the Confidential Information shall be disclosed to only those people within its respective organizations or its agents, consultants, representatives or advisors who have a need to know the information and who are obligated under terms no less restrictive than those imposed by this Agreement on the Receiving Party.</SPAN 29>
<SPAN 30>7. Each party shall have the right to refuse to accept any information under this Agreement, and nothing herein shall obligate either party to disclose to the other party any particular information. </SPAN 30><SPAN 31>Further, each party acknowledges that no contract or agreement providing for a business relationship, of any nature, shall be deemed to exist unless and until a final definitive agreement has been executed and delivered.</SPAN 31>
<SPAN 32>8. If any official approval is required by a government authority or disclose the Confidential Information hereunder, such disclosure is subject to that approval. </SPAN 32><SPAN 33>Both parties shall comply in all respects with applicable laws, regulations and court orders, including but not limited to laws and regulations on export control, in both parties' countries and other applicable countries.</SPAN 33>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"nda-rights-license-purpose-evidence":[0]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 34>9. Disclosure of any information under this Agreement, or otherwise, shall not be construed as granting, directly or by implication, any license under or interest of any kind in any patent, patent application, copyright or other intellectual property rights.</SPAN 34>
<SPAN 35>10. The Disclosing Party represents and warrants that it has the right to disclose the information disclosed under the terms of this Agreement and that disclosure of this information does not conflict with the terms of any agreement between the Disclosing Party and a third party.</SPAN 35>
<SPAN 36>11. The parties hereto shall not be obligated to compensate each other for the disclosure and/or use pursuant to the terms of this Agreement of any information exchanged in connection with this Agreement or the discussions between the parties.</SPAN 36>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"nda-oral-information-evidence":[0]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 37>12. This Agreement supersedes all prior agreements, understandings, representations and statements, whether oral or written, between the parties relating to the disclosure of the Confidential Information. </SPAN 37><SPAN 38>The terms of this Agreement may not be changed except by subsequent written agreement duly signed by an officer of each of the parties.</SPAN 38>
<SPAN 39>13. Subject to Paragraph </SPAN 39><SOURCE_LEADS>{"nda-survival-continuity-evidence":[2]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 40>"4" hereof, the obligation of the Receiving Party provided in Paragraph "2" hereof shall continue for three (3) years from the date of each receipt of the Confidential Information, even after termination of this Agreement according to paragraph "3" hereof.</SPAN 40>
<SPAN 41>14. This Agreement shall be governed, construed and interpreted in accordance with the laws of Japan.</SPAN 41>
<SPAN 42>15. The Receiving Party acknowledges that remedies of damages may be inadequate to protect against breach of this Agreement and the Receiving Party agrees in advance to the granting of injunctive or other equitable relief to the Disclosing Party in addition to any other remedy which may be available to the Disclosing Party.</SPAN 42>
<SPAN 43>16. The Disclosing Party does not make any representation or warranty, except as may be specifically provided in writing, as to the accuracy or completeness of the Confidential Information, or as to its utility or suitability for any purpose of the Receiving Party and the Disclosing Party expressly disclaims any right of the Receiving Party to rely thereon, or any liability to the Receiving Party resulting from the use of the Confidential Information.</SPAN 43>
<SPAN 44>IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties by their duly authorized representatives have executed this Agreement as of the Effective Date first set forth above.</SPAN 44>
<SPAN 45>HYBRID NETWORKS, INC. </SPAN 45><SPAN 46>SHARP CORPORATION</SPAN 46>
<SPAN 47>By: /s/ Carl S. Ledbetter By: /s/ Akira Mitarai</SPAN 47>
